headline: Yokohama Rubber Hit by Malware, Halts Production in Key Facilities
body: The Yokohama Rubber Co., Ltd., a prominent player in the global tire industry, reported that a malicious software intrusion has temporarily disrupted operations at several of its manufacturing sites. The cyber incident led to the suspension of key production equipment, causing a pause in the company's output. As technicians work diligently to restore affected systems, a phased resumption of activities is anticipated. There has been no public disclosure of any ransomware demands connected with this event.
